atoms.text: La lucha libre means the free fight in Spanish and is the name for professional wrestling in Mexico. Mexican wrestlers are called luchadores and luchadoras, and they wear bright, colourful masks to hide their identity.

La lucha libre is not only a wrestling match, but a fight between good and evil. Good luchadores are called técnicos, and they fight bad guys who are called rudos.
The biggest wrestling matches are those where the luchadores bet their masks. The luchador who loses the fight must remove his mask. The best luchadores hide their identities for a long time, sometimes forever.

El Santo is one of the most popular and famous luchadores in the history of la lucha libre. He wore a silver mask, and in all his years of fighting, no one was ever able to rip off his mask. El Santo was very private and never took off his mask to reveal his true identity. Later in his career, he also starred in films, but he always made sure to wear his silver mask.
